pairs.locus: Gaufredus Malaterra, De rebus gestis Rogerii 2.33
pairs.question: Quomodo persequebatur unus mille?
pairs.answer: Quia Deus suus vindicat eos et Dominus in profundo iniquitatum suarum clavibus irae suae concluserat illos.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question and self-answer, both quoting Scripture, on how Serlo's 36 men routed thousands. Framing dropped before the question: 'Si autem prophetam admirantes requirimus dicentem:' (meta-narration of the asking). Framing dropped before the answer: 'nam hoc istis, ut quondam filiis Israel provenisse cognoscimus, profecto nobismetipsis ex eiusdem prophetae verbis absque mendacio respondere possumus:' (meta-narration of the answering). The answer ends at the first full stop, after 'illos'; what follows ('Deus suus - dico -, non quod eum colendo cognoscebant...') is the author's elaboration on the phrase 'Deus suus' and is cut. No scaffolding inside the span.
